explanation: Constructivist learning is facilitated by interactive, collaborative activities.

question: Following Vygotsky's ideas, a teacher gives hints and cues to students stuck on a problem and lets them try again. The teacher is practicing the concept of: / शिक्षक किस अवधारणा का अभ्यास कर रहा है?
explanation: Providing hints within the ZPD and withdrawing them is scaffolding.

question: According to Piaget, when children can generalize and engage in mental trial and error by forming and testing hypotheses in their heads, they are in: / वे किस अवस्था में होते हैं?
option_b: Concrete operational stage / मूर्त संक्रियात्मक अवस्था
option_c: Formal operational stage / औपचारिक संक्रियात्मक अवस्था
explanation: Hypothetical, abstract mental testing marks the formal operational stage.

question: If (2x-10°) and (3x-50°) are complementary angles, then the value of (4x+40°) is: / यदि पूरक कोण हैं तो (4x+40°) का मान है:
explanation: Solving 2x-10+3x-50=90 gives x=30, so 4x+40=160°.

question: In a quadrilateral ABCD, if AB||DC, ∠B=70° and AB=CD, then: / किसी चतुर्भुज में:
explanation: Isosceles trapezium co-interior angles give ∠A=∠C=110°.

question: One of the factors of 4x²+9y²+12xy-5(2x+3y)-14 is: / एक गुणनखंड है:
explanation: Factoring the quadratic in (2x+3y) yields (2x+3y-7).

question: Observations in ascending order: 28,31,47,51,a,a+3,71,74,78,90. If median is 61.5, the mean is: / माध्य है:
explanation: Median 61.5 gives a=60; the mean of the data equals 59.3.

question: A student arranged -20,-150,0,23,46 in descending order as -150,-20,0,23,46. Most appropriate response about the student? / सबसे उपयुक्त कथन:
option_a: Understood the concept but arranged in increasing order by mistake / अवधारणा समझी पर आरोही क्रम में व्यवस्थित किया
option_b: Does not know the concept of integers / पूर्णांकों की अवधारणा पता नहीं
option_c: Needs to recall rules of addition of integers / जोड़ के नियमों का पुनःस्मरण
option_d: Written the numbers in correct order / सही क्रम में लिखा है
explanation: Student understands ordering but mistakenly used increasing (ascending) order.

question: Product of two rational numbers is 8/25. If one is -32/25 and the reciprocal of the other is x, then value of (8x+2x)? [as printed] / मान क्या है?
explanation: Computed from the given rational-number product relation.

question: Perimeters of two circular fields C1 and C2 are 40π m and 96π m. Radius of third field C3 whose area equals sum of areas of C1 and C2? / तीसरे खेत की त्रिज्या?
On which numeration system are clocks based? / घड़ियाँ किस संख्या प्रणाली पर आधारित हैं?
explanation: Clocks use the sexagesimal (base-60) system for minutes and seconds.

question: Which measurements (in cm) can be the sides of a right triangle? / कौन से मापन समकोण त्रिभुज की भुजाएँ हो सकते हैं?
explanation: 14²+48²=50², so 14,50,48 form a right triangle.

question: Which problem is inter-disciplinary in nature? / कौन सी समस्या अंतःविषयक प्रकृति की है?
option_a: How many lines of symmetry in a figure / आकृति में कितनी सममिति रेखाएँ
option_b: Write your name and draw lines of symmetry in each letter / अपना नाम लिखकर प्रत्येक अक्षर में सममिति रेखाएँ
option_c: Draw lines of symmetry in a geometrical figure / ज्यामितीय आकृति में सममिति रेखाएँ
option_d: Draw the mirror image of a figure / दर्पण प्रतिबिम्ब बनाइए
explanation: Writing name + drawing symmetry links language and geometry, so inter-disciplinary.

question: A and D on same side of segment BC: AB=5, AC=8, BC=4, BD=8, CD=5. Then: / तब:
explanation: AC=BD, AB=CD, BC common → △ABC≅△DCB by SSS.

question: If a+b=17/6 and ab=2, then (a-b) where a>b is: / (a-b) का मान?
Renu loses 15% selling A for ₹382.50 and gains 12% selling B for ₹616. Selling both for ₹1180, her percentage gain is: / लाभ प्रतिशत?
Which statements about project method in teaching mathematics are correct? (A) learning by doing (B) learner role minimum (C) turns learners into discoverer (D) always based on deduction / सही कथन?
explanation: Project method is learning-by-doing that turns learners into discoverers: A and C.

question: A swimming pool 20m×15m×4m. Cost of plastering floor and walls at ₹42/m²? / प्लास्टर की लागत?
'Developing understanding of patterns is essential for teaching algebra.' Which represents the correct reason? / सही कारण?
option_a: Patterns have real-life application unlike algebra / पैटर्न में वास्तविक अनुप्रयोग
option_b: Patterns are associated with generalization / पैटर्न सामान्यीकरण से सम्बन्धित है
option_c: Making patterns enhances creative mindset / रचनात्मक मानसिकता बढ़ाता है
option_d: Patterns are comparatively easier / तुलनात्मक रूप से आसान है
explanation: Patterns connect to generalization, which is central to algebra.

question: Which is/are the purpose of formative assessment? (A) Making assessment a part of teaching (B) Ranking and placement of children (C) Providing feedback to children / लक्ष्य?
explanation: Formative assessment integrates assessment into teaching and provides feedback: A and C.

question: Which statement(s) is/are true? (A) A number never exceeds its square (B) All negative numbers exceed their cubes (C) A number never exceeds its cube (D) Square root of a prime is not rational / सत्य कथन?
explanation: Only D is universally true; square root of a prime is irrational.

question: Which is the most appropriate 'Method of proof' for proving √2 is irrational? / सबसे उपयुक्त विधि?
explanation: Proof by contradiction is standard and most appropriate for √2 being irrational.

question: Rajiv invested ₹7000 at 20% p.a. for 1.5 yrs compounded half-yearly; Amit invested ₹8000 at 10% p.a. for 2 yrs compounded annually. Difference in interest at maturity? / ब्याज में अंतर?
explanation: Rajiv interest=₹2317, Amit interest=₹1680; difference=₹637.

question: Pie chart data (computers sold): Jan 700, Feb 840, Mar 750, Apr 890, May 820 [plus 500]. Difference between central angles for March and January? / केंद्रीय कोणों में अंतर?
If x,y,z are respectively faces, vertices and edges of a triangular pyramid, then: / तो:
explanation: For a triangular pyramid x=4,y=4,z=6: 2x+3y-2z=8.

question: Tests which provide information about relative performance of members of a specific group are called: / कहलाते हैं:
option_a: Criterion referenced tests / मानदंड संदर्भित परीक्षण
explanation: Tests comparing relative performance within a group are norm-referenced.

question: Which is an effective TLM to introduce shapes, perimeter, area and characteristics of polygons? / प्रभावी शिक्षण-अधिगम सामग्री?
explanation: Geoboard is best for exploring shapes, perimeter, area and polygon properties.

question: [Algebraic expression evaluation as printed] then the value of ... is: / मान:
explanation: Commission marked all options correct (Z=ALL) for this question.

question: Height of a cylinder is three times its base radius. If base area is 616 cm², capacity in litres? (π=22/7) / धारिता (लीटर में)?
explanation: r=14, h=42; volume=25872 cm³=25.872 litres.

question: The value of √5043×√50 / (√32×√1323) is: / मान:
explanation: Simplifying the surd expression gives 205/84.

question: 'While teaching Discount on items a teacher can plan a trip to a local market.' Most appropriate reason? / सबसे उपयुक्त कारण?
option_a: Provides opportunity to see 'sales' advertisements and discuss calculation with shopkeepers / विज्ञापन देखने और गणना पर चर्चा का अवसर
option_b: Time for enjoyment for teacher and students / मौज-मस्ती का समय
option_c: Mandatory field trip per NCF 2005 / एनसीएफ 2005 द्वारा अनिवार्य
option_d: Formally learn mathematical concepts / औपचारिक रूप से अवधारणाएँ
explanation: Market trip lets students see real 'sales' ads and discuss discount calculation.

question: If 5(3x+4)-8(6x+7)=9x-8, then value of (3x+4)? / मान?
explanation: Solving gives x=-2/3, so 3x+4=2.

question: Which number is not divisible by 72? / कौन सी संख्या 72 से विभाज्य नहीं है?
explanation: 95142 is not divisible by 8, hence not by 72.

question: Process A: Galvanization to prevent rusting. Process B: Electroplating of copper. Choose correct: / सही विकल्प:
option_a: A is chemical change, B is physical change
option_b: Both A and B are physical changes
option_c: Both A and B are chemical changes
option_d: A is physical change, B is chemical change
explanation: Galvanization is physical; copper electroplating (redox) is chemical.

question: A ray of light travels from an optically denser to a rarer medium. Change in the frequency of light? / आवृत्ति में परिवर्तन?
option_c: First increase then decrease / प्रथम वृद्धि फिर ह्रास
explanation: Frequency of light does not change when crossing media; only speed changes.

question: Samples of 4 metals A,B,C,D added to solutions; results shown. Order of reactivities of these metals? / अभिक्रियाशीलता का क्रम?
explanation: From displacement results, reactivity order is C<A<B<D.

question: Choose correct statements about soils (clayey/loamy/sandy/humus). / मृदा के बारे में सही कथन:
explanation: Commission treated all options as correct (Z=ALL) per answer key.

question: Excerpt on Darwin and Wallace evolving life forms. What does it illustrate about the nature of Science? / विज्ञान की प्रकृति?
option_a: Science progresses by following the scientific method / वैज्ञानिक विधि
option_b: Science is tentative / विज्ञान अस्थायी है
option_d: Science is value neutral / मूल्य-निरपेक्ष है
explanation: Ideas changing with new evidence shows science is tentative.

question: Four test tubes A(glucose), B(turmeric), C(detergent), D(pure water). Which observation when you add litmus/phenolphthalein? / क्या देखेंगे?
option_a: Blue litmus paper in each tube / नीला लिटमस
option_b: Red litmus paper in each tube / लाल लिटमस
option_c: Few drops of phenolphthalein in each tube / फीनॉलफ्थेलिन
explanation: Commission treated all options as correct (Z=ALL) for this item.

question: Which method of reproduction is common to fungus, moss and fern? / कवक, काई और पर्णांग में कौन सी जनन विधि समान है?
explanation: Spore formation is the common reproduction method in fungus, moss and fern.

question: A student thinks air contracts on heating. Which strategy would you adopt to challenge this alternative conception? / रणनीति?
option_a: Fill a plastic bottle with hot water, cap tightly, keep aside, note observations
option_b: Take help of textbook for examples where air expands
option_c: Attach a deflated balloon to a bottle of air, place in boiling water bath, note observations
option_d: Explain conduction vs convection to show air is a poor conductor
explanation: Balloon-on-bottle in boiling water gives direct evidence that air expands on heating.

question: Identify metals by reaction with water: (A) reacts violently with cold water (B) reacts with steam only (C) does not react with water / धातुओं की पहचान:
explanation: Potassium (cold water), Iron (steam only), Copper (no reaction).

question: Becquerel excerpt on fogged plate without sunlight. What does it illustrate about science? / विज्ञान के बारे में क्या दर्शाता है?
option_a: Science is a solitary pursuit / अकेले की गतिविधि
option_b: Scientific knowledge is tentative / वैज्ञानिक ज्ञान अस्थायी
option_c: Science is procedural more than creative / कार्यविधिक अधिक
option_d: Scientific discovery can be serendipitous / खोज संयोगवश हो सकती है
explanation: The accidental discovery of radioactivity shows science can be serendipitous.

question: Which cannot be separated by crystallization? / क्रिस्टलीकरण द्वारा पृथक नहीं किया जा सकता?
option_a: Separation of Alum from impure sample / फिटकरी
option_b: Mixture of Zinc chloride and Lead chloride / जिंक और लेड क्लोराइड
option_c: Solution of methyl alcohol and potassium permanganate / मिथाइल अल्कोहल और परमैंगनेट
option_d: Harvesting salt from impure sample / लवण शस्य
explanation: Methyl alcohol (liquid) + KMnO4 solution cannot be separated by crystallization.

question: Consider S1: Non-zero work must be done on a moving particle to change its momentum. S2: To change momentum a non-zero net force should act on it. / सही विकल्प:
explanation: S1 false (direction change needs no work); S2 true (force changes momentum).

question: Which is NOT done during treatment of waste water? / अपशिष्ट जल उपचार में क्या नहीं किया जाता?
option_a: Waste water enters a grit and sand removal tank
option_b: Inorganic impurities like nitrates and phosphates removed by chlorination
option_c: Sand, grit and pebbles settle by decreasing speed
option_d: Sludge scraped out and skimmer removes grease
explanation: Chlorination disinfects; it does not remove nitrates/phosphates, so B is not done.

question: Teacher asks 'why did the bowl not sink? What will make it sink?' Which process skill is being developed? / कौन सा प्रक्रिया कौशल?
explanation: Asking 'why/what will' encourages hypothesizing about outcomes.

question: Assertion (A): Small intestine is the site of complete digestion of food. Reason (R): Villi have a large surface area which helps absorption. / सही विकल्प:
option_a: Both A and R true but R not correct reasoning for A
option_d: Both A and R true and R is correct reasoning for A
explanation: Both true; villi's large surface area explains complete digestion/absorption site.

question: Teacher remarks 'A scientist is open-minded.' What does this highlight about scientists? / यह क्या उजागर करता है?
option_a: They also consider ideas that go against their own ideas / विरुद्ध विचारों का संज्ञान
option_b: They openly share ideas with everyone / मुक्त रूप से साझा
option_c: They do not agree with other scientists' views / असहमत
option_d: They constantly come up with new ideas / नए विचार
explanation: Open-mindedness means considering ideas even against one's own views.

question: Which task is least suitable for developing understanding of the relation of science with society? / सबसे कम उपयुक्त कार्य?
option_a: Group project on latest developments in science and technology
option_b: Concept map on sources of energy
option_c: Poster competition on contribution of Indian scientists
explanation: A concept map on energy sources least shows science's relation with society.

question: Match hormones (Column A) with deficiency diseases (Column B): Adrenal, Growth, Thyroxine, Insulin. / सुमेलित कीजिए:
explanation: Adrenal-salt imbalance, Growth-dwarfism, Thyroxine-goitre, Insulin-diabetes.

question: Glass-and-paper inverted water demonstration; students give explanations. What was the objective? (A) experiments are only route (B) construct explanations from observations (C) encourage questions / उद्देश्य?
explanation: Objective: encourage constructing explanations and asking questions (B and C).

question: Match the animal with mode of feeding: Housefly, Humming bird, Cockroach, Infants. / सुमेलित कीजिए:
explanation: Housefly-sponging, Humming bird-sucking, Cockroach-biting/chewing, Infants-suckling.

question: Free ends of a circuit connected to wires A,B,C,D. Which wire produces least heat? / कौन सी तार न्यूनतम ताप उत्पन्न करेगी?
explanation: Wire D has the least resistance, hence least heat (commission answer: b).

question: Which is a mismatched set among gypsum, bleaching powder, slaked lime, Plaster of Paris? / बेमेल समुच्चय?
option_c: Slaked lime / CaO / lowering soil acidity
explanation: Slaked lime is Ca(OH)2, not CaO, so this set is mismatched.

question: Which will NOT contribute to professional development of science teachers? / पेशेवर विकास में योगदान नहीं करेगा?
option_a: Regular meetings with teachers from neighbouring schools
option_b: Regular reading of science content given in science textbooks
option_c: Visits to planetariums, industries and science museums
option_d: Cultivation of hobbies like robotics and electronics
explanation: Merely re-reading school textbook content does not add to professional development.

question: Which attributes would you associate with 'Scientific temper'? (A) Perseverance (B) Creativity in framing/breaking problems (C) Scepticism to non-scientific beliefs (D) Commitment to cultural preservation / गुण?
explanation: Scientific temper: perseverance, creativity and scepticism (A, B, C).

question: Which statement is true regarding cyclones? / चक्रवातों के संबंध में सत्य कथन?
option_a: Cool air rises and low pressure is created
option_b: Warm air rises and high pressure is created
option_c: Cool air rises and high pressure is created
option_d: Warm air rises and low pressure is created
explanation: In cyclones warm air rises creating a low-pressure region.

question: Assertion (A): While preparing dough for bread, baking powder is added along with yeast to facilitate fermentation. Reason (R): Baking powder acts as food for yeast. / सही विकल्प:
option_a: Both A and R true but R not correct reasoning
option_d: Both A and R true and R is correct reasoning
explanation: Yeast ferments; baking powder is a chemical leavener and not yeast food — both false.

question: Match organism (Column A) with its action (Column B): Yeast, Protozoan, Bacteria, Virus. / सुमेलित कीजिए:
explanation: Yeast-bread, Protozoan-malaria, Bacteria-cholera, Virus-AIDS.

question: Assertion (A): Science textbooks should include biographies of scientists. Reason (R): Narrating biographies inspires students by showing scientists follow a universal scientific method. / सही विकल्प:
option_a: Both A and R true but R not correct reasoning
option_d: Both A and R true and R is correct reasoning
explanation: A true; but a single 'universal scientific method' is a misconception, so R false.

question: Which part of the solar cooker is responsible for greenhouse effect? / हरितगृह प्रभाव के लिए उत्तरदायी भाग?
option_a: Outer cover of the solar cooker / बाहरी आवरण
option_c: Black coloured coating inside the box / काली परत
explanation: The glass sheet lets in sunlight and traps heat, causing the greenhouse effect.

question: Sana recorded 98.6°F and Priya recorded 38.4°C body temperature. Which statement is correct? / सही कथन?
option_a: Body temperature of Priya is more than Sana's / प्रिया का तापमान सना से अधिक
option_b: Both have same body temperature / दोनों का समान
option_c: Both suffering from fever / दोनों बुखार से ग्रस्त
option_d: Body temperature of Sana is more than Priya's / सना का अधिक
explanation: 98.6°F=37°C; Priya's 38.4°C is higher, so Priya's temperature is more.

question: [Reading passage on pelicans] Q91 comprehension item (option text not fully legible in scan).
explanation: Comprehension question on the pelican passage (options OCR-reconstructed).

question: Which one of the following words is nearest opposite in meaning to the word 'retrieve'?
explanation: 'Retrieve' means recover; its opposite is 'abandon'.

question: Study the statements: (A) Baby pelicans pick food from parents' pouches. (B) Fish are kept in pouches and eaten when hungry.
explanation: Passage contradicts both statements about pelican pouches, so both are wrong.

question: Identify the clause in the underlined part: 'When the fish collect in the shallows, pelicans simply scoop them up.'
explanation: 'When the fish collect in the shallows' is an adverb clause of time.

question: Pelicans' webbed feet make them —.
explanation: Webbed feet make pelicans powerful swimmers.

question: Pelicans beat their wings over water also to —.
option_a: Push the fish towards the shallow water
explanation: They beat wings to drive fish towards shallow water.

question: How does the brown pelican catch the fish?
option_a: By storing the fish in their pouch
option_c: By cornering the fish into low waters
option_d: By diving on the fish from above
explanation: The brown pelican catches fish by diving from above.

question: Pelicans usually live —.
explanation: Pelicans usually live near water bodies like coastlines, lakes and rivers.

question: Identify the clause of the underlined part: 'Chemical pesticides, which damage the eggs of pelicans, devastate the sea birds.'
explanation: 'which damage the eggs of pelicans' modifies a noun, so it is an adjective clause.

question: [Poem 'Meadows have surprise'] What does the poet mean by 'velvet grass'?
explanation: 'Velvet grass' means grass as soft and smooth as velvet.

question: How will you find a rabbit?
option_d: When he is in his burrow
explanation: The still rabbit is noticed only when he hops.

question: Which surprises do the meadows NOT hold for you?
option_b: Hopping of a frog out of the brook
explanation: The poem does not mention a frog hopping out of the brook.

question: According to the poem, which kind of house is NOT found in the meadows?
explanation: A stable is human-made, not a meadow house.

question: 'A butterfly unfolding its drinking straw's.' Which figure of speech is used?
explanation: 'Drinking straw' is a metaphor for the butterfly's proboscis.

question: Study the statements: (A) The rabbit is hiding in a burrow. (B) The buttercup is tempting a butterfly.
explanation: Rabbit sits still (not hiding); buttercup tempts butterfly — B right, A wrong.

question: Mrs. Usha Rani supports learners to speak English using the language for day-to-day purposes and formulaic usages. What does she develop?
explanation: Day-to-day functional usage develops Basic Interpersonal Communication Skills (BICS).

question: A teacher reads a short seven-sentence text; learners listen and recreate it near to it. This strategy is known as?
explanation: Listening and reconstructing a text is paragraph dictation (dictogloss).

question: A teacher collects a pattern of learners' errors, discusses them monthly without naming, and asks reflection. This practice is known as?
explanation: Systematic study of error patterns; key accepts providing feedback / error analysis (b/c).

question: Select two appropriate reasons to promote school-based assessment.
explanation: SBA promotes autonomy and lets schools plan assessment — options a and b.

question: Rahul connects a new grammatical form with what he has already learned. Which strategy is this?
explanation: Linking prior knowledge with new learning is a cognitive strategy.

question: Which is true in terms of the objectives of Learning Outcomes?
explanation: Learning outcomes promote competency-based learning and language for specific purposes (a,d).

question: Vani reads an article to get a general overview. This reading is known as?
explanation: Reading for a general overview or gist is skimming.

question: What is the innateness hypothesis in language acquisition and language learning?
option_a: All humans learn languages through physical drilling and conditioning
option_b: All human beings possess language knowledge at birth
option_c: Language is learned as a result of habit formation
option_d: Rejects that all languages have grammars
explanation: Innateness hypothesis: humans possess innate language knowledge at birth (LAD).

question: What does 'content-oriented language inputs' refer to?
option_a: Presentation of the inputs and its processes
option_b: Language inputs that focus on information
option_d: Language input focusing on how language is used
explanation: Content-oriented inputs focus on conveying meaning and information.

question: Which is NOT the aim of multilingualism in school education?
option_a: Learning mother tongue as language and medium of learning
option_b: Learning mother tongue, Hindi and English under three-language formula
option_c: All children begin schooling with mother tongue and add languages
option_d: Making use of learners' languages for teaching-learning
explanation: The three-language formula is a policy, not the direct aim of multilingualism.

question: Which describes 'procedural knowledge' in learning grammar?
option_a: Knowing what a grammatical form is and using it
option_b: Learning the rules of grammar and producing it later
option_c: Understanding how a grammatical form works from a grammar book
explanation: Procedural knowledge = applying grammatical forms in communication.

question: Which one does not come under institutional writing?
explanation: Notes of condolence are personal, not institutional writing.

question: Words that we recognize when we hear or see them are known as:
explanation: Words recognized on hearing/seeing are receptive vocabulary.

question: Which approach advocates words and word chunks as the foundation for language learning?
explanation: The lexical approach treats word chunks as the foundation of language learning.

question: Which educational philosophy advocates real-world/case-based learning environments rather than predetermined sequences of instruction?
explanation: Constructivism supports real-world, case-based learning over fixed sequences.

question: [गद्यांश: किताबों/कागज का इतिहास] पतले कागजों पर किस लिपि में लिखा जाता था?
explanation: पपाइरस के पतले कागजों पर हाइरोग्लाइफ लिपि में लिखा जाता था।

question: कौन-सा शब्द समूह से भिन्न है?
explanation: 'ऊँचे-नीचे' विपरीत अर्थ वाले शब्द हैं, बाकी पुनरुक्ति हैं।

question: ताल पत्तों को किताब का स्वरूप देने के लिए कौन-से लोग लिख सकते थे?
option_c: जिनके पास सुंदर ताल पत्र थे
explanation: सुंदर हस्तलेखन वाले लोग ताल पत्तों पर लिख सकते थे।

question: भिन्न वाक्य की पहचान करें।
option_a: किताब की शुरूआत ताल के पत्तों पर लिखकर बाँधने से हुई
option_d: किताब की कोई कल्पना नहीं होती
explanation: 'समस्त संसार किताबें पढ़ता है' गद्यांश की विषयवस्तु से भिन्न है।

question: सामान्यतः मनुष्य का किताब से परिचय किस काल में होने लगता है?
option_a: जीवन के शुरूआती एक-दो वर्ष के बाद
option_c: लगभग तीन वर्ष की अवस्था में
explanation: जीवन के शुरूआती एक-दो वर्ष के बाद किताब से परिचय होता है।

question: किन लोगों को ताल पत्तों पर चित्रकारी करने का काम दिया जाता था?
option_a: जिन्हें ताल पत्तों की पहचान थी
option_d: जिन्हें छपाई का काम आता था
explanation: सुंदर चित्रकारी वालों को ताल पत्तों पर चित्रकारी का काम मिलता था।

question: गद्यांश के अनुसार किताब का सबसे पहला स्वरूप कौन-सा है?
option_a: ताल के पत्तों पर लिखी किताब
option_b: पपाइरस पर मशीन से छपी किताब
option_c: पपाइरस पर हाथ से लिखी किताब
explanation: किताब का सबसे पहला स्वरूप पपाइरस पर हाथ से लिखी किताब है।

question: पपाइरस नाम का पौधा किस काम आता था?
option_d: छपाई की मशीन बनाने के लिए
explanation: पपाइरस पौधे से पतला कागज बनाया जाता था।

question: 'लिख' में कौन-सा प्रत्यय लगाकर सार्थक शब्द बनाया जा सकता है?
explanation: लिख + आवट = लिखावट, सार्थक शब्द बनता है।

question: [पद्यांश: यह धरती कितना देती है] रचनाकार स्वयं को किस बात के लिए धिक्कार रहा है?
option_a: धरती माँ के महत्व को न समझ पाने के लिए
option_b: मानवीय गुणों का आचरण न कर पाने के लिए
option_c: किसी भी तरह की फसल न बो पाने के लिए
option_d: श्रम के महत्व की समझ न बन पाने के लिए
explanation: रचनाकार धरती माँ के महत्व को न समझ पाने के लिए स्वयं को धिक्कारता है।

question: 'हम जैसा बोएँगे वैसा ही पाएँगे' पंक्ति के भाव वाले मुहावरे का चयन करें:
explanation: 'जैसी करनी वैसी भरनी' पंक्ति के भाव को व्यक्त करता है।

question: 'रत्न प्रसविनी' का क्या अर्थ है?
explanation: 'रत्न प्रसविनी' का अर्थ रत्नों को जन्म देना है।

question: रचनाकार ने बचपन में कौन-सी फसल बोई थी?
explanation: रचनाकार ने बचपन में स्वार्थ रूप में 'धन' बोया था।

question: 'वसुधा' का समानार्थी है:
explanation: 'वसुधा' का समानार्थी 'धरा' अर्थात पृथ्वी है।

question: रचनाकार ने धरती माता की संतान किसे कहा है?
explanation: रचनाकार ने समस्त मानव जाति को धरती माता की संतान कहा है।

question: श्रीमती उषारानी अंग्रेजी की अध्यापिका दैनिक प्रयोग और भाषा-सूत्रों से छात्रों में किसका विकास करती हैं?
explanation: दैनिक प्रयोग से बुनियादी अंतःवैयक्तिक सम्प्रेषण कौशल (BICS) विकसित होता है।

question: कक्षा सात की अध्यापिका सात वाक्यों वाला संक्षिप्त पाठ पढ़ती है, फिर छात्र उसे पुनःसृजित करते हैं। इस युक्ति को क्या कहेंगे?
explanation: सुनकर पाठ पुनःसृजित करना 'अनुच्छेद श्रुतलेख' कहलाता है।

question: एक अध्यापक कक्षा सात की गलतियों के पैटर्न पहचान कर महीने में चर्चा करती है (नाम बताए बिना)। इस अभ्यास को क्या कहेंगे?
explanation: त्रुटि पैटर्न की चर्चा; कुंजी में पृष्ठपोषण/त्रुटि विश्लेषण (b/c) दोनों स्वीकार्य।

question: विद्यालय आधारित आकलन को समुन्नत करने के लिए दो उपयुक्त कथनों का चयन करें।
explanation: विद्यालय आधारित आकलन स्वायत्तता देता है और योजना बनाने का अवसर — (a) और (b)।

question: राहुल व्याकरण के नए नियम को पहले सीखे से जोड़ पाता है। कौन-सी युक्ति इसके अन्तर्गत आएगी?
explanation: पूर्व ज्ञान को नए से जोड़ना संज्ञानात्मक युक्ति है।

question: अधिगम प्रतिफलों के उद्देश्य के संबंध में कौन-सा कथन सही है?
option_a: विषयवस्तु केंद्रित की तुलना में दक्षता आधारित अधिगम को समुन्नत करना
option_b: रचनात्मक प्रयोगकर्ता होने के लिए भाषा कौशलों में निपुणता
option_c: विषयवस्तु में निपुणता और बाद में प्रयोग
explanation: अधिगम प्रतिफल दक्षता आधारित अधिगम और विशिष्ट प्रयोग को बढ़ावा देते हैं।

question: वाणी एक पाठ का सामान्य परिचय (ओवर व्यू) जानने के लिए पढ़ती है। इसे किस पठन के रूप में जाना जाएगा?
explanation: सामान्य परिचय हेतु पठन 'स्किमिंग' कहलाता है।

question: भाषा अर्जन और अधिगम में सहजात परिकल्पना से क्या तात्पर्य है?
option_a: सभी मनुष्य शारीरिक ड्रिल से भाषा सीखते हैं
option_b: सभी मनुष्य जन्म से ही भाषा ज्ञान रखते हैं
option_c: भाषा आदत निर्माण के रूप में सीखी जाती है
option_d: सभी बच्चे अपने तरीके से सीखते हैं
explanation: सहजात परिकल्पना: मनुष्य जन्म से भाषा ज्ञान रखते हैं (चॉमस्की)।

question: 'विषय अभिमुखी भाषा निवेश' किससे संबंधित है?
option_a: निवेश और इसकी प्रक्रियाओं की प्रस्तुति
option_b: वह भाषा निवेश जो सूचनाओं पर बल देता है
option_d: वह जो भाषा प्रयोग पर बल देता है
explanation: विषय अभिमुखी भाषा निवेश सूचना/अर्थ पर बल देता है।

question: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा विद्यालयी शिक्षा में बहुभाषावाद का उद्देश्य नहीं है?
option_a: मातृभाषा का अधिगम एवं माध्यम के रूप में प्रयोग
option_b: त्रिभाषा सूत्र के अंतर्गत मातृभाषा, हिन्दी और अंग्रेजी का अधिगम
option_c: सभी बच्चे मातृभाषा से आरंभ कर और भाषाएँ जोड़ते हैं
explanation: त्रिभाषा सूत्र एक नीति है, बहुभाषावाद का प्रत्यक्ष उद्देश्य नहीं।

question: व्याकरण अधिगम में 'प्रक्रियात्मक ज्ञान' का कौन-सा कथन सर्वाधिक उपयुक्त वर्णन करता है?
option_a: व्याकरण नियम क्या है और कैसे प्रयोग करना है यह जानना
option_b: नियमों को जानना और बाद में प्रयोग
option_c: नियम व्याकरण पुस्तक में कैसे कार्य करते हैं यह समझना
explanation: प्रक्रियात्मक ज्ञान = व्याकरणिक रूप का वास्तविक प्रयोग जानना।

question: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा संस्थागत लेखन के अन्तर्गत नहीं आएगा?
explanation: संवेदना टिप्पणी व्यक्तिगत है, संस्थागत लेखन नहीं।

question: वे शब्द जिन्हें हम सुनने और देखने पर पहचानते हैं, किस रूप में जाने जाते हैं?
explanation: सुनकर/देखकर पहचाने जाने वाले शब्द ग्रहणशील शब्दावली हैं।

question: भाषा शिक्षण का कौन-सा उपागम शब्दों और शब्द-समूहों को नींव के रूप में अनुशंसित करता है?
explanation: कोश विषयक उपागम शब्दों/शब्द-समूहों को भाषा अधिगम की नींव मानता है।

question: कौन-सा शैक्षिक दर्शन वास्तविक जीवन/केस आधारित अधिगम की अनुशंसा करता है?
explanation: रचनावाद वास्तविक जीवन/केस आधारित अधिगम की अनुशंसा करता है।

question: [गद्यांश: प्रसेनजित राजा] 'ब्राह्मणः प्रायः तत्र गत्वा मुद्राः विलोक्य _____ स्म।' उचितं पदं चित्वा रिक्तस्थानं पूरयत।
explanation: ब्राह्मण अपनी मुद्राएँ देखकर संतुष्ट (तुष्यति) होता था।

question: ब्राह्मणः केन कर्मणा धनम् लब्धम्?
explanation: ब्राह्मण ने पौरोहित्य (पूजा-पाठ) कर्म से धन प्राप्त किया।

question: 'आनीतवान्' - अस्मिन् पदे कः प्रत्ययः वर्तते?
explanation: 'आनीतवान्' में क्तवतु प्रत्यय है (भूतकाल)।

question: कुतश्चिद् प्रदेशात् श्रावस्तीनगरीं आगत्य कः अनिवसत्?
explanation: किसी प्रदेश से श्रावस्ती आकर कोई ब्राह्मण रहने लगा था।

question: शय्यागतः राजा नगरस्य कान् आकारयत्?
explanation: बिस्तर पर लेटे राजा ने नगर के वैद्यों को बुलवाया।

question: अधोलिखितेषु पदेषु किं क्तप्रत्ययान्तं पदं न अस्ति?
explanation: 'गत्वा' क्त्वा प्रत्ययान्त है, क्त प्रत्ययान्त नहीं।

question: प्रसेनजिताभिधः राजा कीदृशः आसीत्?
explanation: प्रसेनजित राजा न्यायप्रिय था।

question: 'नागबलामूलं कुतः प्राप्तम्' - इति कः कं प्रति पृच्छति?
explanation: राजा मातृदत्त से पूछता है कि नागबला की जड़ कहाँ से मिली।

question: एकेन वैद्येन मातृदत्ताय कस्य मूलं सेवितुं निर्दिष्टः?
explanation: वैद्य ने मातृदत्त को नागबला की जड़ सेवन का निर्देश दिया।

question: [श्लोक] अधोलिखितेषु किं पदं तृतीयाविभक्त्यन्तं न अस्ति?
explanation: 'पृथिव्याः' पञ्चमी/षष्ठी विभक्ति है, तृतीया नहीं।

question: पद्यानुसारं, पिता कस्य मूर्तिः भवति?
explanation: श्लोकानुसार पिता प्रजापति की मूर्ति (रूप) है।

question: भारत्याः कोषः सञ्चयात् कं आयाति?
explanation: विद्या रूपी धन संचय (इकट्ठा रखने) से क्षय होता है।

question: सुपुत्रस्य तुलना केन सह कृता?
explanation: सुपुत्र की तुलना अच्छे वृक्ष (सुवृक्ष) से की गई है।

question: खनन् खनित्रेण नरः किं अधिगच्छति?
explanation: कुदाल से खोदता मनुष्य जल (वारि) प्राप्त करता है।

question: वन्द्यानां जनानां हृदयं कीदृशं भवति?
explanation: वन्दनीय लोगों का हृदय दयालु (सदयम्) होता है।

question: अधोलिखितेषु संस्थागतलेखनान्तर्गते किं न गण्यते?
explanation: संवेदना टिप्पणी संस्थागत लेखन में नहीं गिनी जाती।

question: वाणी पाठस्य सामान्यावलोकनार्थं एकं लेखं पठति। तस्याः पठनं किं कथ्यते?
explanation: सामान्य अवलोकन हेतु पठन द्रुतपठन (स्किमिंग) कहलाता है।

question: 'विषयवस्तु-अभिमुखी-भाषा-निविष्टः' (Content-oriented Language inputs) किं अस्ति?
explanation: विषयवस्तु-अभिमुखी निवेश सूचना केन्द्रित होता है।

question: भाषाधिगमाधाररूपेण शब्दानां शब्दाखण्डानां च समर्थनं केन उपागमेन क्रियते?
explanation: शब्द/शब्दखंडों का समर्थन शाब्दिक (लेक्सिकल) उपागम करता है।

question: अधोलिखितेषु किं विद्यालयीयशिक्षायां बहुभाषिकतायाः उद्देश्यः न अस्ति?
option_b: यथासम्भवं भवेत् भाषारूपेण, अधिगम-माध्यमरूपेण च मातृभाषायाः शिक्षणम्
option_c: त्रिभाषासूत्रान्तर्गते मातृभाषायाः, हिन्दीभाषायाः, आङ्ग्लभाषायाः च अध्ययनम्
explanation: त्रिभाषा सूत्र एक नीति है, बहुभाषिकता का प्रत्यक्ष उद्देश्य नहीं।

question: वाणी पाठस्य सामान्यावलोकनार्थं एकं लेखं पठति। तस्याः पठनं किं कथ्यते? (द्रुतपठन)
explanation: सामान्य अवलोकन हेतु द्रुतपठन (स्किमिंग)।

question: विद्यालयाधारित-आकलनस्य संवर्धनाय द्वे उपयुक्तपठने चिनुत।
explanation: विद्यालय आधारित आकलन स्वायत्तता और स्वतंत्र योजना का अवसर देता है (a,b)।

question: किं शैक्षिक-दर्शनं अधोलिखितं समर्थयति? पूर्वनिर्धारितक्रमाणां स्थाने वास्तविक-जगत्विन्यासः अथवा परिस्थित्याधारितशिक्षणम्।
explanation: वास्तविक-जगत् आधारित शिक्षण संरचनात्मकतावाद (रचनावाद) समर्थित है।

question: षष्ठकक्षायाः एकः छात्रः नवीनव्याकरणात्मक-स्वरूपं पूर्वज्ञानेन सह संयोक्तुं समर्थः। अनेन अधोलिखितेषु का पद्धतिः प्रतीयते?
explanation: पूर्वज्ञान से जोड़ना संज्ञानात्मक पद्धति (Cognitive strategy) है।

question: सप्तमकक्षायाः अध्यापिका सप्तवाक्ययुक्तस्य पाठस्य वाचनं करोति, छात्रान् पुनःसृजनं कर्तुं निर्दिशति। इयं पद्धतिः कथ्यते?
explanation: सुनकर पाठ पुनःसृजन अनुच्छेद-श्रुतलेख (paragraph dictation) है।

question: अधिगमपरिणामस्य उद्देश्यानां विषये अधोलिखितेषु किं सत्यम्? (A) योग्यताधारित-अधिगमस्य वर्धनम् ... (D) विशेषप्रयोजनेभ्यः भाषां प्रयोक्तुं छात्राणां समर्थीकरणम्
explanation: योग्यताधारित अधिगम एवं विशेष प्रयोजन हेतु भाषा प्रयोग — (a) एवं (d) सत्य।

question: व्याकरणाधिगमप्रसङ्गे 'प्रक्रियात्मकज्ञानं' अधोलिखितेषु किं कथनं उत्तमरूपेण वर्णयति?
option_b: व्याकरणात्मकस्वरूपं किं भवति, इत्यस्य ज्ञानं, तस्य प्रयोगः च
option_c: व्याकरणनियमानां अधिगमः पश्चात् च अस्य पुनरुत्पादनम्
explanation: प्रक्रियात्मक ज्ञान = व्याकरणिक रूप क्या है और उसका प्रयोग जानना।

question: श्रीमती उषारानी राजकीय-उच्चविद्यालये आङ्गलभाषायाः अध्यापिका, दैनिकप्रयोजनेषु एवं सूत्रात्मकप्रयोगानां (Formulaic Usages) शिक्षणमाध्यमेन छात्रेषु किं विकासयितुं प्रयतते?
explanation: दैनिक प्रयोग से मूल अन्तर्वैयक्तिक सम्प्रेषण कौशल (BICS) विकसित होता है।

question: एका अध्यापिका सप्तमकक्षायाः छात्राणां विशिष्टत्रुटि-उदाहरणानि संगृह्णाति, मासे एकवारं चर्चां करोति। अध्यासोऽयं कथ्यते?
explanation: त्रुटि पैटर्न पर चर्चा प्रतिप्राप्ति-प्रबन्ध (feedback) कहलाती है (आयोग)।

question: यदा वयं शब्दान्, शृण्मः पश्यामः वा, तेषां अभिज्ञानं जायते?
explanation: सुनकर/देखकर पहचाने जाने वाले शब्द ग्रहणशील शब्दावली हैं।

question: [Vegetarianism passage] Which word is most similar in meaning to 'cultivated'?
explanation: 'Cultivated in the mind' means developed/nurtured, so 'developed'.

question: Which word is opposite in meaning to 'tasteless' as used in the passage?
explanation: 'Palatable' (tasty) is the opposite of 'tasteless'.

question: Identify the part of speech of the underlined word: 'This has been central to the Indian Culture.'
explanation: 'This' is a demonstrative pronoun.

question: The implicit message that vegetarianism spreads is —.
explanation: The passage's implicit message is universal love and non-violence.

question: Which is NOT a motive for people to draw to vegetarianism?
option_b: Oppose eating animals out of love
option_c: Find vegetarian food cheaper than non-vegetarian
explanation: Cost is not mentioned as a motive in the passage.

question: Statements: (A) Vegetarianism promotes longer, healthier lives and preserves resources. (B) Not popular because it does not help prevent heart disease. Which is correct?
option_b: Both A and B are correct
option_c: Both A and B are incorrect
explanation: Only A is supported; B (heart disease reason) is not mentioned.

question: Vegetarianism is not as popular as it should be because —.
option_a: It helps the animal kingdom co-exist with man
option_b: It is an inward-looking habit best cultivated in the mind
option_c: We want to preserve earth's natural resources
option_d: It promotes natural way of life
explanation: It is an inward-looking habit best cultivated in the mind.

question: Identify the clause of the underlined part: '...the single most effective way in which we can stop the progression of coronary artery disease.'
explanation: 'in which we can stop...' modifies a noun, so it is an adjective clause.

question: [Self-control passage] Statements: (A) Lack of self-control makes people grief stricken. (B) Harmonious negotiation is required for self-control. Which is correct?
option_b: Both A and B are correct
option_c: Both A and B are incorrect
explanation: Only A is correct per the passage.

question: What must every successful person have?
explanation: Every successful person must have self-control.

question: What did the young woman who was hearing the complaints do?
explanation: She kept calm and smiled despite abusive customers.

question: Harmonious negotiation is needed for —.
explanation: Harmonious negotiation with others is needed for success in life.

question: Which word is opposite in meaning to 'Pleasure'?
explanation: 'Grief' is the closest opposite of 'pleasure'.

question: Which word is most similar in meaning to 'liquid getting thick' as used in the passage?
explanation: 'Coagulate' means a liquid becoming thick/clotted.

question: Identify the part of speech of the underlined word: '...and if this kept up for some time...'
explanation: 'for' shows duration of time, so it is a preposition.

question: Language used in classroom across content areas as the teacher presents and interacts. This language skill is known as?
explanation: Academic content-area language is Cognitive Academic Language Proficiency (CALP).

question: Which is 'assessment for learning'?
option_a: Assessments to know progress at year-end for promotion
option_b: State assessment to diagnose achievement at a stage
option_c: Assessment to monitor progress at end of each term
option_d: Assessments to monitor and improve progress during learning
explanation: Assessment for learning (formative) monitors and improves progress during learning.

question: Which grammatical knowledge does this mean: 'Knowledge about the form, describing it and applying it in limited practice.'
explanation: Knowing about the form and describing it is declarative knowledge.

question: A small text is split into chunks/alternate sentences; a pair dictate to each other and write, then reverse and finalise. This task is known as?
explanation: Learners dictating alternate parts to each other is mutual dictation.

question: What do 'form oriented language inputs' refer to?
option_a: Use of vocabulary, pronunciation and grammar
option_d: Inputs for learning how language is used
explanation: Form-oriented inputs focus on vocabulary, pronunciation and grammar (linguistic form).

question: What is productive vocabulary?
option_a: Words we recognize as we hear
option_b: Words that we fail to recognize
option_c: Words we may recall sometimes while listening
option_d: Words that we use in writing and speaking
explanation: Productive vocabulary = words actively used in writing and speaking.

question: Sandhya reads an article on machine learning to find some information. Her reading is known as?
explanation: Reading to locate specific information is scanning.

question: Which is true of the innateness hypothesis of language acquisition?
option_a: Language is unique only to humans who can speak
option_b: Language faculty makes children conceive language through practice and drilling
option_c: Language faculty in children is responsible for production and acquisition of language
option_d: Efforts of parents, peers and environment are responsible
explanation: Innate language faculty (LAD) is responsible for language production and acquisition.

question: Which are bottom-up listening activities?
option_a: Summarizing, listening to gist, applying background knowledge
option_b: Rearranging jumbled words as one listens
option_c: Recitation of poetry, extempore, debate, discussions
option_d: Dictation, cloze listening, multiple-choice, identifying positive statements
explanation: Bottom-up: dictation, cloze listening, MCQs, identifying statements from sounds/words.

question: 'All learners begin education in the mother tongue and add many more languages as they move forward.' In language-in-education policy this is known as?
option_a: Three language formula for school education
option_b: Mother as base for language education
explanation: Starting with mother tongue then adding languages is mother tongue-based multilingualism.

question: Which statement would you NOT endorse for teaching-learning of poetry?
option_a: Poetry is for working with language
option_d: Poetry is for exercising the imagination of learners
explanation: Using poetry mainly to teach grammar goes against its aesthetic purpose.

question: Class VIII assignment: in pairs brainstorm and develop two arguments for and against a topic. What type of writing? [Commission answer (a)]
explanation: Presenting arguments for and against is discursive writing; commission marked (a).

question: Task: given a ₹1800 hotel menu, order food for four (one vegetarian, one mushroom-allergic) and keep ₹70 for return travel. What does this develop?
explanation: Analysing menu, constraints and budget develops higher-order thinking; key: (a).

question: What does 'Pedagogical realization of materials' mean in language teaching?
option_a: Embedding pedagogy into materials to enable teacher to adopt the pedagogy
option_b: Enabling the teacher to understand the pedagogy
option_d: Embedding activities and tasks to promote pedagogy
explanation: It means embedding the teaching methodology directly into instructional materials.

question: 'Learning is a search for meaning; learning must start with issues around which learners actively make meaning.' Which philosophy recommends this?
explanation: Learning as a search for meaning reflects constructivism.

question: [गद्यांश: अध्ययन] 'अध्ययन ने नए क्षितिज का उद्घाटन किया है।' वाक्य से आशय है:
option_a: अध्ययन से अपार संभावनाओं के द्वार खुलते हैं
option_b: अध्ययन से विकास का नया क्षेत्र सामने आया है
option_c: अध्ययन कल्पनाशीलता को पुष्ट करता है
option_d: नई-नई पुस्तकों का विमोचन होना ज़रूरी है
explanation: अध्ययन से अपार संभावनाओं के द्वार खुलते हैं।

question: 'जागृति' का विलोम है-
explanation: 'जागृति' का विलोम 'सुषुप्ति' है।

question: 'समृद्धि' का अर्थ है-
explanation: गद्यांशानुसार 'समृद्धि' का अर्थ 'संपन्नता' है।

question: 'पढ़ने के साथ गुनना' का क्या तात्पर्य है?
option_b: पढ़े गए पर वक्तव्य तैयार करना
explanation: 'पढ़ने के साथ गुनना' का तात्पर्य चिंतन-मनन करना है।

question: अध्ययन के द्वारा क्या प्राप्त किया जा सकता है?
explanation: अध्ययन से रूचियों का विस्तारण प्राप्त किया जा सकता है।

question: 'अध्ययन से विकास, उन्नति और प्रगति के रास्ते खुलते हैं।' यह भाव किस पंक्ति में व्यक्त है?
option_a: आत्मिक शान्ति का लाभ पाया जा सकता है
option_c: अध्ययन प्रत्येक क्षेत्र की मूल समृद्धि का आधार है
option_d: अध्ययन के लिए असीमित विषय क्षेत्र हैं
explanation: 'अध्ययन प्रत्येक क्षेत्र की मूल समृद्धि का आधार है' पंक्ति में यह भाव है।

question: गद्यांश में अध्ययन के किस विषय का उल्लेख नहीं हुआ है?
explanation: गद्यांश में साहित्य, संगीत, विज्ञान, धर्म, दर्शन का उल्लेख है, इतिहास का नहीं।

question: उपसर्ग की दृष्टि से 'समालोचना' का विग्रह है-
explanation: 'समालोचना' का विग्रह सम् + आलोचना है।

question: [गद्यांश: विज्ञापन] प्राचीन काल में विज्ञापन का क्या स्वरूप था?
explanation: प्राचीन काल में विज्ञापन का स्वरूप मुनादी द्वारा करवाना था।

question: गद्यांश में विज्ञापन के किस स्वरूप का उल्लेख नहीं हुआ है?
explanation: गद्यांश में भित्ति लेखन स्वरूप का उल्लेख नहीं है।

question: विज्ञापन का सामान्य अर्थ क्या है?
option_a: केवल विशिष्ट लोगों को संदेश देना
option_b: केवल सामान्य लोगों को जानकारी देना
explanation: विज्ञापन का सामान्य अर्थ किसी नयी सूचना को जन-जन तक पहुँचाना है।

question: गद्यांश के अनुसार कौन-सा वाक्य सही है?
option_a: यह कला भी है और एक व्यवसाय भी है
option_b: विज्ञापन की आवश्यकता घटती जा रही है
option_c: सांस्कृतिक आयोजन विज्ञापन की दुनिया से अछूते हैं
explanation: विज्ञापन कला भी है और व्यवसाय भी — यह कथन सही है।

question: किस शब्द में 'इत' प्रत्यय का प्रयोग स्पष्ट रूप से नहीं हुआ है?
explanation: 'ललित' में 'इत' प्रत्यय स्पष्ट रूप से नहीं है, बाकी तीनों में है।

question: 'प्राचीन' का विलोम है:
explanation: 'प्राचीन' का विलोम 'नवीन' है।

question: 'विज्ञापन के क्षेत्र में क्रान्ति आई' वाक्य से आशय है-
option_a: विज्ञापन से लोगों को जानकारी नहीं पहुँच रही
option_b: विज्ञापन का विषय-क्षेत्र घट रहा है
option_c: विज्ञापन की सार्थकता बढ़ गयी है
option_d: विज्ञापन के क्षेत्र में अभूतपूर्व परिवर्तन हुआ है
explanation: 'क्रांति आई' का आशय विज्ञापन के क्षेत्र में अभूतपूर्व परिवर्तन है।

question: वह भाषा जो कक्षा में विभिन्न विषयक्षेत्रों में प्रयुक्त होती है। इस भाषा कौशल को क्या कहेंगे?
option_a: जीवन के वास्तविक उद्देश्यों के लिए भाषा
explanation: विषयक्षेत्रों की अकादमिक भाषा संज्ञानात्मक अकादमिक भाषायी निपुणता (CALP) है।

question: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा 'अधिगम के लिए आकलन' है?
option_a: वर्ष के अंत में प्रगति जानने और अगली कक्षा में भेजने हेतु आकलन
option_b: अवस्था विशेष में उपलब्धि का निदानात्मक आकलन
option_c: प्रत्येक टर्म के अन्त में प्रगति पर्यवेक्षण हेतु आकलन
option_d: प्रक्रिया के दौरान प्रगति के पर्यवेक्षण और सुधार हेतु आकलन
explanation: अधिगम के लिए आकलन प्रक्रिया के दौरान प्रगति सुधारता है (रचनात्मक)।

question: निम्नलिखित कथन में निहित व्याकरणिक ज्ञान किस प्रकार का है? 'नियमों के बारे में ज्ञान, उनका वर्णन करना और सीमित अभ्यास में प्रयोग।'
explanation: नियमों के बारे में जानना और वर्णन करना घोषणात्मक ज्ञान है।

question: एक संक्षिप्त पाठ के छोटे खंड जोड़ों में दिए जाते हैं; एक पढ़कर सुनाता (डिक्टेट) है, दूसरा लिखता है, फिर उल्टा। इस कार्य को क्या कहेंगे?
explanation: जोड़ों में एक-दूसरे को डिक्टेट करना पारस्परिक-श्रुतलेख है।

question: 'संरचना-अभिमुखी-भाषा-निविष्टः' (Input) का अभिप्रायः?
explanation: संरचना-अभिमुखी निवेश शब्दावली, उच्चारण, व्याकरण के प्रयोग पर केन्द्रित है।

question: उत्पादक-शब्दावलिः किम् अस्ति? (उत्पादक शब्दावली क्या है?)
explanation: उत्पादक शब्दावली = लेखन और सम्भाषण में सक्रिय रूप से प्रयुक्त शब्द।

question: सन्ध्या किसी सूचना खोजने हेतु यंत्रशिक्षण पर एक लेख पढ़ती है। उसका पठन कहलाता है-
explanation: विशेष सूचना खोजने हेतु पठन क्रमवीक्षण (Scanning) है।

question: भाषाधिग्रहणस्य भाषाधिगमस्य अन्तर्जातता-प्राक्कल्पना (Innateness Hypothesis) विषये किं कथं सत्यम्?
option_a: भाषा केवल मनुष्यों के लिए विशिष्ट
option_c: बालक की सहज भाषा-क्षमता भाषा उत्पादन/अर्जन के लिए उत्तरदायी
explanation: सहज भाषा क्षमता (LAD) भाषा उत्पादन और अर्जन के लिए उत्तरदायी है।

question: अधोलिखितेषु का ऊर्ध्वगामी-श्रवण-गतिविधिः अस्ति? (bottom-up)
explanation: बॉटम-अप: श्रुतलेख, क्लोज श्रवण, बहुविकल्पीय प्रश्न (ध्वनि/शब्द से अर्थ)।

question: 'विद्यालये सर्वे छात्राः स्वशिक्षां मातृभाषायां प्रारभन्ते... अन्याः भाषाः अपि शिक्षन्ते।' भाषानीतिविषये यह कथन कहलाता है-
explanation: मातृभाषा से आरंभ कर अन्य भाषाएँ जोड़ना मातृभाषाधारित बहुभाषिकता है।

question: काव्यस्य (Poetry) अध्ययन-अध्यापनाय अधोलिखितेषु किं कथनं न अनुमोदनीयम् (Endorse)?
explanation: काव्य को मुख्यतः व्याकरण शिक्षण हेतु प्रयोग अनुमोदनीय नहीं है।

question: एका अध्यापिका अष्टमकक्षायाः छात्रेभ्यः लेखनस्य कः प्रकारः निर्दिशति? युग्मेषु मस्तिष्कोद्दोलनं (Brainstorm) कृत्वा द्वौ तर्कौ पक्षे विपक्षे च।
explanation: पक्ष-विपक्ष में तर्क देना बहुविषयात्मक (Discursive) लेखन है।

question: अधोलिखिते कार्ये किं समाविष्टम्? ₹1800 की भोजनसूची (Menu) से चार जनों हेतु भोजन (एक शाकाहारी, एक मशरूम एलर्जी), ₹70 वापसी हेतु।
explanation: आयोग द्वारा विकल्प (a) उत्तर दिया गया (उच्चस्तरीय चिंतन कौशल भी संगत)।

question: भाषाध्यापने 'पदार्थानां/सामग्रीणां शिक्षाशास्त्रीयः अवबोधः' इत्यस्य कः अभिप्रायः?
option_a: शिक्षाशास्त्रं अंगीकरणे अध्यापिकां समर्थीकर्तुं, पदार्थेषु/सामग्रीषु शिक्षाशास्त्रस्य सन्निवेशनम्
option_d: भाषा-शिक्षाशास्त्रस्य संवर्धनाय गतिविधीनां कार्याणां च सन्निवेशनम् (Embedding)
explanation: सामग्री में शिक्षणशास्त्र का समावेश कर अध्यापिका को समर्थ बनाना।

question: अधिगमः एकं अर्थान्वेषणम् अस्ति। अतएव आरम्भः छात्रान् परितः तैः विषयैः सह कर्तव्यः। अयं विचारः केन शिक्षादर्शनेन समर्थितः?
explanation: अधिगम को अर्थ की खोज मानना रचनात्मकतावाद (constructivism) समर्थित है।

question: [गद्यांश: ब्रह्मा-पृथ्वी संवाद] 'भवद्भिः'-इत्यस्मिन् पदे का विभक्तिः किं च वचनम् अस्ति?
explanation: 'भवद्भिः' में तृतीया विभक्ति बहुवचन है।

question: सागरादीनां सर्वेषां वहने पृथिवी किं अनुभवति?
explanation: महासागरादि को धारण कर पृथ्वी सन्तोष अनुभव करती है।

question: अधोलिखितेषु पदेषु किं द्वितीयाविभक्तेः उदाहरणं न अस्ति?
explanation: 'कोटिसंख्यकैः' द्वितीया का उदाहरण नहीं है (तृतीया)।

question: 'ब्रह्मणः वचनं श्रुत्वा पृथिवी अतीव _____ जाता।' अधोलिखितेषु उचितं पदं चित्वा रिक्तस्थानं पूरयत।
explanation: ब्राह्मण के वचन सुनकर पृथ्वी अतीव गंभीरा हुई।

question: पृथिव्याः निर्माणं केन कृतम्?
explanation: पृथ्वी का निर्माण ब्रह्मा द्वारा किया गया।

question: पृथिवी किं वहन्ती अतीव क्लेशं अनुभवति?
explanation: पृथ्वी पापात्मा-प्राणी को ढोने में अतीव क्लेश अनुभव करती है।

question: पृथिव्याः उपरि के स्थापिताः न सन्ति?
explanation: पृथ्वी के ऊपर जलद (बादल) स्थापित नहीं हैं।

question: ब्रह्मा कस्मिन् तन्मयभावेन संलग्नः आसीत्?
explanation: ब्रह्मा सृष्टिनिर्माण कार्य में तन्मय भाव से संलग्न थे।

question: [गद्यांश: चत्वारो ब्राह्मणपुत्राः] 'ततश्चैकेनाभिहितम्'- अस्मिन् पदे सम्यक् सन्धि-विच्छेदः कुरुतः?
explanation: सन्धि-विच्छेद: ततः + च + एकेन + अभिहितम् (तीन सन्धियाँ)।

question: एकेन ब्राह्मणपुत्रेण औत्सुक्यात् किं कृतः?
explanation: एक ब्राह्मण पुत्र ने जिज्ञासावश अस्थि संचय किया।

question: गद्यानुसारं बुद्धिहीनानां तुलना केन सह कृता?
explanation: गद्यानुसार बुद्धिहीनों की तुलना 'सिंहकाराः' से की गई।

question: चतुर्षु ब्राह्मणपुत्रेषु बुद्धिमान् जनः सर्वदा किं कार्यं करोति स्म? उचितपदं चित्वा रिक्तस्थानं पूरयत।
explanation: बुद्धिमान् व्यक्ति सदा विचारपूर्वक (विचिन्त्यैव) कार्य करता है।

question: 'गच्छ त्वं गृहं यतः ते विद्या नास्ति'-इति कथनं केन कं च कथितम्?
explanation: द्वितीय बुद्धिमान् द्वारा कथन कहा गया।

question: ब्राह्मणपुत्रैः मार्गे कस्य अस्थीनि दृष्टानि?
explanation: ब्राह्मण पुत्रों ने मार्ग में मृत सिंह की हड्डियाँ देखीं।

question: सुबुद्धिः कस्मात् अवतीर्य गृहं गतः?
explanation: सुबुद्धि वृक्ष से उतरकर घर चला गया।

question: कक्षायां विविधविषयवस्तूनां क्षेत्रे भाषा प्रयुक्ता यावत् अध्यापकः प्रस्तौति। एतत् भाषाकौशलं किं कथ्यते?
explanation: विषयक्षेत्रों की अकादमिक भाषा संज्ञानात्मक-शैक्षणिक भाषा प्रावीण्य (CALP) है।

question: अधोलिखितेषु किं अधिगमाय आकलनम् अस्ति?
option_c: प्रत्येकसत्रस्य अन्ते छात्राणां प्रगतेः (Progress) अनुक्षणार्थं आकलनम्
option_d: अध्यापन-अध्ययनप्रक्रियायां छात्राणां प्रगतेः अनुक्षणार्थं संवर्धनार्थं च आकलनम्
explanation: अधिगम के लिए आकलन प्रक्रिया के दौरान प्रगति सुधारता है।

question: अधोलिखितं कथनं व्याकरणात्मकज्ञानस्य कं प्रकारं सूचयति? संरचनायाः ज्ञानं, अस्याः वर्णनं, सीमित अभ्यासे च प्रयोगः।
explanation: संरचना का ज्ञान और वर्णन विवरणात्मक (घोषणात्मक/Declarative) ज्ञान है।

question: अधोलिखितं कार्यं किं कथ्यते? एकं लघुपाठः द्वयोः पृथक् खण्डयोः निर्मितः; प्रत्येकः छात्रः अन्यं वाक्यं कथयति, अन्यः लिखति; पुनः वैपरीत्येन।
explanation: एक-दूसरे को डिक्टेट करना पारस्परिक-श्रुतलेख (Mutual Dictation) है।

question: संरचना-अभिमुखी-भाषा-निविष्टः (Input) कः अभिप्रायः?
explanation: संरचना-अभिमुखी निवेश शब्दावली, उच्चारण, व्याकरण के प्रयोग को दर्शाता है।

question: उत्पादक-शब्दावलिः किम् अस्ति?
option_b: ते शब्दाः यान् वयं अभिज्ञातुं न शक्नुमः
option_c: अस्माभिः श्रवणकाले कदाचित् पुनः स्मृताः शब्दाः
option_d: अस्माभिः लेखने सम्भाषणे च प्रयुक्ताः शब्दाः
explanation: उत्पादक शब्दावली = लेखन और सम्भाषण में प्रयुक्त शब्द।

question: सन्ध्या काञ्चित् सूचनां अन्वेष्टुं यन्त्रशिक्षणे एकं लेखं पठति। तस्याः पठनं कथ्यते-
explanation: विशेष सूचना खोजने हेतु पठन क्रमवीक्षण (Scanning) है।

question: भाषाधिग्रहणस्य भाषाधिगमस्य अन्तर्जातता-प्राक्कल्पना (Innateness Hypothesis) विषये किं कथं सत्यम् अस्ति?
option_c: छात्राणां सहजा भाषा अध्यापकवर्गः, छात्रेषु भाषाधिग्रहणाय उत्तरदायी
option_d: इयं अभिभावकानां प्रयत्नानि, समकक्षिणः, बालकस्य समीपवर्तिनः च
explanation: बालक की सहज भाषा क्षमता भाषाधिग्रहण/उत्पादन के लिए उत्तरदायी है।

question: अधोलिखितेषु का ऊर्ध्वगामी श्रवण-गतिविधिः अस्ति? (bottom-up)
explanation: बॉटम-अप: श्रुतलेख, क्लोज श्रवण, बहुविकल्पीय प्रश्न प्रयोग।

question: 'विद्यालये सर्वे छात्राः स्वशिक्षां मातृभाषायां प्रारभन्ते... अन्याः भाषाः अपि शिक्षन्ते।' शिक्षायां भाषानीतिविषये एतत् कथनं ज्ञायते-
explanation: मातृभाषा से आरंभ कर अन्य भाषाएँ जोड़ना मातृभाषाधारित बहुभाषिकता है।

question: काव्यस्य (Poetry) अध्ययन-अध्यापनाय अधोलिखितेषु किं कथनं न अनुमोदनीयम् (Endorse)?
explanation: काव्य को मुख्यतः व्याकरण शिक्षण हेतु प्रयोग अनुमोदनीय नहीं है।

question: एका अध्यापिका अष्टमकक्षायाः छात्रेभ्यः लेखनस्य कः प्रकारः? युग्मेषु मस्तिष्कोद्दोलनं (Brainstorm) कृत्वा पक्षे विपक्षे द्वौ तर्कौ।
explanation: पक्ष-विपक्ष में तर्क देना बहुविषयात्मक (Discursive) लेखन है।

question: अधोलिखिते कार्ये किं समाविष्टम्? ₹1800 भोजनसूची (Menu) से चतुर्जनेभ्यः भोजनम् (एकः शाकाहारी, अन्यः मशरूम एलर्जी), ₹70 गृहगमनार्थम्।
explanation: आयोग ने विकल्प (a) उत्तर माना (उच्चस्तरीय चिंतन कौशल भी संगत)।

question: भाषाध्यापने 'पदार्थानां/सामग्रीणां शिक्षाशास्त्रीयः अवबोधः' इत्यस्य कः अभिप्रायः?
option_a: शिक्षाशास्त्रं अंगीकरणे अध्यापिकां समर्थीकर्तुं, पदार्थेषु/सामग्रीषु शिक्षाशास्त्रस्य सन्निवेशनम्
option_d: भाषा-शिक्षाशास्त्रस्य संवर्धनाया गतिविधीनां कार्याणां च सन्निवेशनम् (Embedding)
explanation: सामग्री में शिक्षणशास्त्र का समावेश कर अध्यापिका को समर्थ बनाना।

question: अधिगमः एकं अर्थान्वेषणम् अस्ति। अतएव अधिगमस्य आरम्भः छात्रान् परितः तैः विषयैः सह कर्तव्यः। अयं विचारः केन शिक्षादर्शनेन समर्थितः?
explanation: अधिगम को अर्थ की खोज मानना रचनात्मकतावाद (constructivism) समर्थित है।

question: An effective strategy for solving ill-defined problems is / अपरिभाषित समस्याओं को हल करने के लिए एक प्रभावी रणनीति है :
option_a: Focusing on functional fixedness / कार्यात्मक स्थिरता पर ध्यान केंद्रित करना
explanation: Means-ends analysis is effective for ill-defined problems.

question: Which of the following set of qualities characterizes critical thinking? / निम्नलिखित में से गुणों का कौन-सा समूह समालोचनात्मक चिंतन की विशेषताओं को दर्शाता है? (i) Ability to question (ii) Ability to self-reflect (iii) Ability to test previously held assumptions (iv) Ability to think convergently
explanation: Critical thinking: questioning, self-reflection, testing prior assumptions.

question: Which of the following statement about the role of heredity and environment in the development of a child is correct? / बच्चे के विकास में आनुवंशिकता और वातावरण की भूमिका के संबंध में कौन-सा कथन सही है?
option_a: While heredity contributes in unfolding, entirety of development is solely based on environmental factors.
option_b: While heredity provides the genetic blueprint, expression of those genes can be influenced by environmental factors.
option_c: Both heredity and environment contribute 50% each in development.
option_d: Dispositions are linked with environmental factors but actual development occurs on basis of heredity.
explanation: Heredity gives blueprint; environment influences gene expression.

question: Arpita and Anu give their books to each other since both consider it 'an equal exchange of favours'. At which level of Kohlberg's moral development theory are Arpita and Anu? / अर्पिता और अनु कोहलबर्ग के नैतिक विकास सिद्धांत के किस स्तर पर हैं?
explanation: Equal exchange of favours reflects pre-conventional moral level.

question: Assertion (A): When unable to 'make meaning', efficient readers slow down and reread the text clarifying confusion before continuing. Reason (R): Metacognition hinders the process of meaning-making. / अभिकथन और कारण पढ़िए।
option_c: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is correct explanation of (A).
option_d: Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is not correct explanation of (A).
explanation: Assertion true; metacognition aids, not hinders, meaning-making.

question: Which of the following sets describe ways in which a school should be inclusive? / कौन-सा समूह उन तरीकों का वर्णन करता है जिनमें एक स्कूल को समावेशी होना चाहिए? (i) Modification of curriculum as required (ii) Expecting students to totally adapt to school's culture (iii) Fostering an ethos of care and respect (iv) Opportunities for collaborative learning
explanation: Inclusion: curriculum modification, care/respect ethos, collaborative learning.

question: Which of the following statement about socialization is correct? / समाजीकरण के बारे में कौन-सा कथन सही है?
option_a: Socialization cultivates shared sources of meaning and value.
option_d: Norms and beliefs cannot be acquired through socialization process.
explanation: Socialization cultivates shared sources of meaning and value.

question: Role of a teacher in 'reciprocal teaching' is characterized by: / 'पारस्परिक शिक्षण' में एक शिक्षक की भूमिका की विशेषता है:
option_a: a shift from being a support and guide towards gradual release of responsibility to students.
option_b: being a more recipient of the suggestions given by students.
option_c: the position of dominance and sole authority to disseminate the information to students.
option_d: his/her position of being a passive observer throughout the process.
explanation: Reciprocal teaching: gradual release of responsibility to students.

question: An assessment approach aiming to support students' learning is characterized by: / विद्यार्थियों के सीखने का समर्थन करने के उद्देश्य से एक आकलन प्रक्रिया की विशेषता है:
option_a: Consideration of method of solving the problem along with the outcome.
option_b: Focus on inaccuracies only while ignoring the process and endeavours.
option_c: Exams done at the end of the year through objective type questions.
option_d: Evaluation and marking based on standardized quiz-based tests.
explanation: Supportive assessment considers method of solving, not just outcome.

question: Which of the following is an effective strategy of emotional regulation? / भावनात्मक नियमन की एक प्रभावी युक्ति कौन-सी है?
option_a: Channelling emotions to use them as a source of inspiration and creative endeavours.
option_b: Waiting until emotions escalate to the point of losing control.
option_d: Suppressing emotions in order to conform to social norms.
explanation: Channelling emotions into creative endeavours regulates them effectively.

question: Learning about a concept/category is easier if: / किसी अवधारणा/श्रेणी के बारे में सीखना आसान है यदि:
option_a: previous knowledge about the concept is not activated.
option_b: concept is represented in abstract and complex ways.
option_c: familiar examples are provided while introducing the concept.
option_d: lots of advanced information is given to create cognitive load.
explanation: Concept learning is easier with familiar examples provided.

question: According to Jean Piaget, what is the role of symbolic thought in cognitive development? / जीन पियाजे के अनुसार, संज्ञानात्मक विकास में सांकेतिक चिंतन की क्या भूमिका होती है?
option_a: Symbolic thought develops after cognitive development is complete.
option_b: Symbolic thought impacts cognitive development only in children with language delays.
option_c: Symbolic thought causes mental confusion and hinders cognitive development.
option_d: Symbolic thought facilitates cognitive development by allowing for mental processes like problem-solving.
explanation: Symbolic thought facilitates cognitive development via mental problem-solving.

question: Which of the following typical characteristics is a child struggling with dysgraphia likely to show? / लेखन-वैकल्य से जूझ रहे बच्चे में कौन-सी विशेषताएँ दिखाई देने की संभावना है?
option_b: Impulsiveness; difficulty in concentrating and forgetfulness.
option_c: Slow in written work; makes poorly formed letters, has difficulty copying from blackboard.
explanation: Dysgraphia: slow, poorly formed letters, copying difficulty.

question: A teacher is providing learners with the chances to be exposed to and analyze concepts to help them understand content through her support. This is an example of: / यह किसका उदाहरण है?
explanation: Analyzing concepts with teacher support exemplifies guided discovery.

question: Which of the following statements is correct about gender development in contemporary times? / समकालीन समय में जेंडर विकास के बारे में कौन-सा कथन सही है?
option_a: Gender is purely and solely determined by an individual's anatomy at birth.
option_b: Gender exists on a binary concept — one is either male or female.
option_c: Gender identity is influenced by cultural conceptions.
option_d: Gender identity is not influenced by socialization.
explanation: Gender identity is influenced by cultural conceptions.

question: Which of the following hinders problem-solving? / कौन-सी प्रक्रिया समस्या-समाधान में बाधा डालती है?
option_a: Breaking down large complex problems into manageable smaller problems.
option_b: Fixating on a single trait of a composite problem.
option_d: Using a solution which was effective in solving a similar problem earlier.
explanation: Fixating on a single trait hinders problem-solving.

question: Activities which ______ are detrimental to students' motivation to learn. / गतिविधियाँ जो ______ विद्यार्थियों के सीखने की अभिप्रेरणा के लिए हानिकारक हैं।
option_b: connect with real life of students
option_c: cater to students' needs and interests
option_d: aim at intangible goals decided solely by the teacher
explanation: Intangible teacher-set goals harm students' motivation to learn.

question: Following Lev Vygotsky's ideas on learning, a teacher should: / लेव वायगोत्स्की के विचारों का अनुसरण करते हुए, एक शिक्षक को चाहिए कि वह:
option_a: encourage students to continually compete with each other.
option_b: prevent integration of cultural knowledge in discussions.
option_c: capitalize on dialogue and group learning during activities.
option_d: discourage verbalization and thinking aloud among students.
explanation: Vygotsky: capitalize on dialogue and group learning.

question: Jean Piaget gave importance to ______ in the course of development and learning. / जीन पियाजे ने विकास और सीखने के क्रम में ______ को महत्त्व दिया।
option_c: children's maturation and readiness to learn
explanation: Piaget emphasized children's maturation and readiness to learn.

question: Assertion (A): Teachers should ensure enough 'wait time', the length of time a teacher pauses after asking a question. Reason (R): Diversity is an asset and not an obstacle. / अभिकथन और कारण।
option_b: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).
option_d: Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A).
explanation: Both true; diversity reason does not explain wait-time assertion.

question: Assertion (A): Children learn most effectively when they are criticized frequently for their mistakes. Reason (R): Frequent criticism makes children self-reliant which helps in improving their academic performance. / अभिकथन और कारण।
option_a: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).
option_d: Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A).
explanation: Both false; frequent criticism does not help children learn.

question: Inclusion of students belonging to disadvantaged backgrounds requires: / वंचित पृष्ठभूमि से संबंधित विद्यार्थियों को शामिल करने के लिए आवश्यक है कि:
explanation: Inclusion requires consideration of socio-cultural diversity.

question: Contemporary theorists believe that childhood is: / समकालीन सिद्धांतकारों का मानना है कि बचपन:
option_a: A life stage that is awaiting adulthood.
option_b: A stage associated with divinity, purity and goodness.
explanation: Contemporary theorists see childhood as variable and dynamic.

question: Assertion (A): A middle school language arts teacher selects stories and clippings from newspapers and magazines that portray men and women in non-traditional roles. Reason (R): Countering prevalent gender stereotypes by presenting other models is an effective way to overcome gender bias. / अभिकथन और कारण।
option_b: Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A).
option_d: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).
explanation: Both true; countering stereotypes explains portraying non-traditional roles.

question: The process of bringing back the information stored in memory to current state is called ______. / वह कौन-सी प्रक्रिया है जो स्मृति में संग्रहीत जानकारी को वर्तमान स्थिति में लाने के लिए प्रयोग की जाती है?
explanation: Retrieval brings stored memory information to current state.

question: Which of the following statements about classroom assessment is correct? / कक्षा आकलन के बारे में कौन-सा सही है?
option_a: Use of norm-referenced assessment that compares performance to peers motivates students to learn meaningfully.
option_b: Focus of assessment should be paper-pencil rather than non-written behaviours to maintain objectivity.
option_c: Formative assessment should include tasks which inform teachers about what students know before they begin teaching.
option_d: Summative assessment does not serve any purpose and should not be undertaken.
explanation: Formative assessment informs teachers of students' prior knowledge.

question: Assertion (A): Adaptations such as audio tapes, text-to-speech software, extended time facilitate learning for students who are visually challenged. Reason (R): Teachers should adapt the curriculum to provide equity and meet needs of diverse learners. / अभिकथन और कारण।
option_a: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).
option_c: Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A).
explanation: Both true; curriculum adaptation explains aids for visually challenged.

question: Assertion (A): Adolescents have difficulty with emotional regulation and inhibiting their impulses and are quite susceptible to peer pressure. Reason (R): Physiological and hormonal changes during adolescence impact the behaviour of adolescents in a variety of ways. / अभिकथन और कारण।
option_c: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).
option_d: Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A).
explanation: Both true; hormonal changes explain adolescent emotional difficulty.

question: Gifted children: / प्रतिभाशाली बच्चे:
option_a: excel in all academic as well as co-curricular areas.
option_b: exhibit high cognitive abilities as well as skills of social communication.
option_c: get distracted easily and have low concentration span.
explanation: Gifted children absorb information quickly and accurately.

question: Which of the following statements about language and cognition is not correct as per Lev Vygotsky's theory? / लेव वायगोत्स्की के सिद्धांत के अनुसार कौन-सा कथन सही नहीं है?
option_b: Inner speech is used for mental reasoning.
option_c: Language inevitably affects the way a child thinks.
option_d: External speech is used to converse with others.
explanation: Incorrect claim: language hinders cognitive development (Vygotsky).

question: The greatest number which can divide the numbers 282, 696 and 1616, leaving the same remainder 6 in each case, is: / वह अधिकतम संख्या जिससे 282, 696 और 1616 को भाग करने पर प्रत्येक स्थिति में 6 शेष बचे है:
Which of the following is not written correctly in Roman Numerals? / कौन-सा रोमन संख्याओं में सही नहीं लिखा गया है?
explanation: VXII is not a valid Roman numeral form.

question: If (5-7x)/(8+3x) = -40/7 then what is the value of (2x+3)/(x+9)? / यदि (5-7x)/(8+3x) = -40/7 है, तो (2x+3)/(x+9) का मान क्या है?
explanation: Solving gives x=-5, so expression equals -7/4.

question: The length of a diagonal of a square is 8 cm. If its area (in cm²) is y, then value of (3y-15) is: / किसी वर्ग के एक विकर्ण की लंबाई 8 cm है। यदि इसका क्षेत्रफल y है, तो (3y-15) का मान है:
explanation: Area y=32; 3y-15 equals 81.

question: A certain sum becomes ₹6,300 at 10% p.a. in 4 years at simple interest. What will be the amount of the same sum in 2 years at the same rate, if interest is compounded yearly? / चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज द्वारा 2 वर्षों में कितनी होगी?
explanation: Principal 4500; compound amount in 2 years is ₹5,445.

question: The expression 9x² - 12xy + 21x + 4y² - 14y + 12 is factorised as: / व्यंजक का गुणनखंडन है:
explanation: Factorises as (3x-2y+3)(3x-2y+4).

question: In a parallelogram PQRS, ∠P = 2x+20°, ∠Q = 2y-40°, ∠R = 5x-100° and ∠S = 3y-100°. Then the value of (x+y) is equal to: / (x+y) का मान बराबर है:
explanation: x=40, y=60; x+y equals 100°.

question: Two alternate interior angles formed by the intersection of two parallel lines by a transversal are (5y-10°) and (7y-90°). Then, the value of (3y-20°) is: / (3y-20°) का मान है:
5/7 of 35/12 ÷ 28/9 + 96/15 ÷ 8/5 × 3/4 - 7/56 is equal to: / बराबर है:
explanation: Simplifies to 397/112 = 3 61/112.

question: A man sold two articles for ₹850 each. On one article he earns a profit of 25% and on the other he suffers a loss of 15%. What is his overall profit? / कुल मिलाकर उसे कितना लाभ हुआ?
explanation: CP=1680, SP=1700; overall profit ₹20.

question: A four-digit number 3x15 is a multiple of 3. Then, the sum of all the possible values of x is: / x के सभी संभावित मानों का योगफल है:
explanation: x=0,3,6,9; sum of values is 18.

question: Sides AB and AC of a triangle ABC are produced to points D and E respectively. Bisectors of angles CBD and BCE intersect at point O. If ∠BAC = 50°, then ∠BOC is equal to: / ∠BOC बराबर है:
Which of the following figures has rotational symmetry, but no line symmetry? / किस आकृति में घूर्णन समिति है, परंतु कोई रेखा समिति नहीं है?
explanation: Parallelogram has rotational but no line symmetry.

question: The distance between two parallel sides of a trapezium is 8 cm. If perimeter is 52 cm and non-parallel sides are 10 cm each, then area (in cm²) is: / क्षेत्रफल (cm² में) है:
explanation: Parallel sides sum 32; area = ½×32×8 = 128.

question: [(x²+y²-z²)² - (x²-y²+z²)²] / [(y+z)(z-y)] is equal to: / बराबर है:
explanation: Difference of squares simplifies to -4x².

question: The difference between the median and the mode of the observations 13, 16, 12, 14, 19, 12, 13, 14, 12, 15, 16, 15, 18, 19 is: / माध्यक और बहुलक का अंतर है:
explanation: Median 14.5, mode 12; difference 2.5.

question: If 12500 = 5^x × 2^y, then which of the following can be expressed in the form 5^(x-1) × 2^(2y)? / किसको व्यक्त किया जा सकता है?
Height of a right circular cylinder is 6 m. If three times the sum of areas of its two circular bases is twice its curved surface area, then volume (in m³) is: / आयतन (m³ में) है:
explanation: r=4, h=6; volume = 96π m³.

question: ABC is a right triangle, right-angled at B. D and E are points on side AB such that AD = DE = EB. Then, (DC²-BC²)/(AC²-EC²) is equal to: / बराबर है:
explanation: Using Pythagoras ratios, expression equals 1/2.

question: Numbers from 8 to 92 were written on paper slips and kept in a box. A slip was taken out without looking. What is the probability that the number is a multiple of 7? / प्रायिकता क्या है?
explanation: 12 multiples of 7 out of 85; probability 12/85.

question: Which of the following statements with respect to linear equations is not true? / रैखिक समीकरण के संदर्भ में कौन-सा कथन सही नहीं है?
option_a: In an equation, at least one of the two expressions must contain the variable.
option_b: The equality that involves variables is an equation.
option_c: If we multiply or divide both sides of the equality by the same whole number, it still holds.
option_d: The value of equation (6y+10) depends on the value of 'y'.
explanation: Multiplying both sides by zero loses information; statement false.

question: Which among the following is most appropriate for assessing problem-solving ability? / समस्या-समाधान क्षमता को आँकने के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त है?
option_a: Assess child's ability to recall the solution of a problem solved previously.
option_b: Assess child's ability to use knowledge in a familiar situation.
option_c: Assess child's ability to use knowledge and skills in a new situation.
option_d: Assess child's ability to solve word problems only.
explanation: Applying knowledge in a new situation assesses problem-solving.

question: In which of the following situations do the results have an equal chance of occurring? / किन परिस्थितियों में परिणामों के घटित होने के संयोग बराबर हैं?
option_a: The chances of a train being on time or late.
option_b: The chances of a ticket which was waitlisted being confirmed.
option_c: A student getting a question from the 3 chapters she prepared, out of 5.
option_d: Captains of two teams tossing a coin to decide which team will bat first.
explanation: Coin toss gives equally likely outcomes.

question: A method of assessment, useful in theme-based learning, undertaken over a period of time and generally involves collection and analysis of data is a: / यह विधि कहलाती है:
explanation: Data collection over time in theme-based learning is Project.

question: A middle school mathematics teacher writes patterns 9+1=10=10×1, 99+1=100=10×10, 999+1=1000=10×100. Which mathematical concept can be addressed? / कौन-सी अवधारणा? (i) greatest 1-digit, 2-digit numbers (ii) introduce concept of 10000 (iii) introduce concept of addition
explanation: Pattern addresses greatest-digit numbers and introducing 10000.

question: Which among the following is usually not used as a strategy in Summative Assessment? / योगात्मक आकलन में प्रायः नहीं होता?
explanation: Observation is not typical summative-assessment strategy.

question: Which of the following is not true for rational numbers? / परिमेय संख्याओं के लिए सही नहीं है?
explanation: Rational numbers not closed under division (division by zero).

question: Which of the following does not represent the correct sequence of teaching the given concepts? / शिक्षण के सही क्रम को नहीं दर्शाता?
explanation: Fractions precede decimals; option D order is incorrect.

question: The 'Baudhayana Sulba Sutra', part of rich Indian knowledge system, gives the same result as given by: / वही परिणाम देता है, जैसा दिया गया है:
explanation: Baudhayana Sulba Sutra parallels Pythagoras' theorem.

question: According to NCF 2005, which is not a narrow aim of teaching mathematics? / गणित शिक्षण का संकीर्ण उद्देश्य नहीं है?
option_b: To enhance ability in solving algebraic equations
option_c: To develop the right attitude for problem-solving
option_d: To develop an ability to identify geometrical shapes
explanation: Right attitude for problem-solving is a higher, not narrow, aim.

question: A metal X burns in oxygen with a white flame to form a white ash. Identify X and the type of reaction: / X और अभिक्रिया के प्रकार को पहचानिए:
explanation: Magnesium burns with white flame; combination reaction.

question: Which of the following is not an advantage of using manure over fertilizers? / खाद का उपयोग करने का लाभ नहीं है?
option_b: It increases the number of friendly microbes.
option_d: It enhances the water holding capacity of the soil.
explanation: Manure does not fix atmospheric nitrogen; not its advantage.

question: Arrange the following statements about the process of digestion in cows in the correct sequence: (i) Chewing of cud (ii) Partial digestion of food (iii) Storage of food in stomach (iv) Quick swallowing of food / सही क्रम में व्यवस्थित कीजिए:
explanation: Swallow, store, partial digestion, then chew cud.

question: A ball is thrown upwards. Which statement is true at the highest point before it begins to fall down? / अधिकतम ऊँचाई पर कौन-सा कथन सही है?
option_a: Velocity is zero; net force is zero.
option_b: Velocity is zero; gravitational force acts.
option_c: Velocity is maximum; gravitational force acts.
option_d: Velocity is maximum; net force is zero.
explanation: At highest point velocity zero but gravity still acts.

question: Read statements: I: Isotopes of an element have the same chemical properties. II: Chemical properties do not depend on number of neutrons. / सही विकल्प चुनिए:
option_a: Both true, but II is not correct reason for I.
option_b: I is true, but II is false.
option_d: Both true and II is the correct reason for I.
explanation: Both statements true; II correctly explains I.

question: Which of the following processes leads to production of lactic acid? / कौन-सा प्रक्रम लैक्टिक अम्ल का उत्पादन करता है?
option_d: Rise of dough after addition of yeast and sugar
explanation: Anaerobic respiration in human muscles produces lactic acid.

question: Seema and Ashutosh set up a simple pendulum; distance between two extreme positions is 'D'. Seema observes bob covers D/4 in 2 seconds. Ashutosh observes bob covers 3D/2 in 10 seconds. Which is true? / कौन-सा सत्य है?
option_a: Time period is 12 seconds in both cases.
option_b: Time period calculated by Seema is greater than by Ashutosh.
option_c: Time period calculated by Ashutosh is greater than by Seema.
option_d: Time period will be same in both cases as it depends on mass.
explanation: Seema's calculated period (16s) exceeds Ashutosh's (13.3s).

question: Mahesh left the wheat dough in the open. After a few days, it started to emit a foul smell. What could be the reason? / इसका क्या कारण हो सकता है?
option_a: Growth of bacteria in the wheat dough
option_b: Growth of saprophytic fungi which break down carbohydrates
option_c: The oxidation of bran which produces lactic acid
option_d: The reduction of bran particles in dough which weaken gluten-forming proteins
explanation: Bacteria growing in dough produce foul-smelling compounds.

question: Two circuits A and B are placed in close vicinity. Circuit A has a galvanometer connected to closed circuit. Circuit B has a battery and a key. Initially key not inserted. What is observed if key is inserted and later removed? / क्या प्रेक्षण होगा?
option_a: Momentary galvanometer deflections in opposite directions that die out shortly.
option_b: Momentary deflections in the same direction that die out shortly.
option_c: The galvanometer shows no deflection throughout.
option_d: Momentary deflection that dies out and no effect when key is removed.
explanation: Electromagnetic induction gives opposite momentary deflections on/off.

question: What is the reason for preferring pressure cookers over open pans for cooking food quickly at high altitudes? / प्रेशर कुकर को वरीयता देने का क्या कारण है?
option_a: Lowering of boiling point due to increase in atmospheric pressure.
option_b: Increase in boiling point due to decrease in atmospheric pressure.
option_c: Lowering of boiling point due to decrease in atmospheric pressure.
option_d: Increase in boiling point due to increase in atmospheric pressure.
explanation: At altitude low pressure lowers boiling point; cooker compensates.

question: Consider statements: (i) Density of Ball A = 13600 kg/m³ (ii) Density of Ball B = 7800 kg/m³ (iii) Ball A is heavier than Ball B (iv) Volume of Ball A is identical to Ball B. If Balls A and B are submerged into two identical containers of water, which holds true? / कौन-सा सही होगा?
option_a: Balls A and B will displace equal amounts of water.
option_b: Ball A will displace less water than Ball B.
option_c: Ball A will displace more water than Ball B.
option_d: Both A and B will not displace any water.
